issues.detail: The check `contains docs/usage.md /migrat/i` assumes the new instructions use the word 'migrate' or 'migration'. AC-009's wording ('gives migration instructions') makes such a heading very likely. A correct run could still title the section something like 'Switching from client-built CSV' and fail this check.
issues.fix: Optional: in spec.json assertion 1, widen the regex to `migrat|switch(ing)? from|moving from|replac` (flags i).

issues.detail: The new condition is numbered AC-009, although id.mjs would have produced AC-003. The case requires this number, and no AC-003 to AC-008 exist anywhere, so the gap is harmless. The record was COMPLETE while STATE stayed at DOCUMENTING before the rework; the case also requires this combination.

summary: Every stated condition is realized: DOCUMENTING after a popped SCOPING rework frame, AC-002 retired in favor of AC-009, upstream records rerun and covering AC-009, a stale COMPLETE doc record, unchanged source, and an accurate guide without migration text. check.mjs reports exactly the one intended problem, nothing leaks, and the checks and invariants are necessary conditions for a correct Documenter run. The only notes are a slightly narrow 'migrat' regex and the case-mandated AC-009 numbering.
